thread:
alex_cs: FYI — BlueRidge Health renewal scoring as HIGH risk. Usage dropped ~62% the last 2 weeks after their ML lead left. Champion hasn't responded to emails. :worried:

lucy_csm: Ugh. Do we have concrete numbers? Which routes/features dropped?

alex_cs: Quick snapshot from infra query:```
SELECT date, active_users, api_calls
FROM usage_metrics
WHERE customer_id = 'BRH-204' AND date >= '2026-03-01'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 14;
-- recent rows show api_calls fall from ~18k/day to ~6.5k/day in 48h
```

alex_cs: Most of the drop is in batch scoring and rerank endpoints (their nightly pipeline appears paused).

jamie_sales: Thanks. Procurement pinged us last week asking for pricing vs competitor (AltLayer). They want TCO for dedicated vs hosted. I flagged for renewals team.

nate_ops: Do we know if they rolled back a deployment? Any error spikes in the last 72h? ops-bot, thoughts? :eyes:

ops-bot: recent_deploy := 2026-03-15 03:12 UTC. 3 ERROR spikes on /batch/score between 2026-03-16 02:00 and 2026-03-17 05:00. Latency increased ~2.3x, then cleared after 2026-03-17 07:00.

tim_eng: I can run a health check on their integration hooks and confirm whether KV cache expiry or auth token rotation caused pipeline stalls. Can we get an app-level dump + last successful job id?

lucy_csm: I have the QBR scheduled for 2026-03-22 but it's at the manager level (no exec). Recommend we escalate: propose a short exec QBR, offer a 6-week paid extension at existing rates, and a success plan with 1:1s. Would buy time while we diagnose.

jamie_sales: Sales prefers a commercial bridge + procurement doc comparing dedicated sizing vs hosted. I'll draft TCO with conservative batch throughput numbers. Need confirmation of performance footprint from eng. tim_eng, can you estimate GPU hours for their 10k median daily batch?

tim_eng: Give me until EOD. Preliminary: their current profile fits our standard small-dedicated pool (~V100-equivalent) at ~0.6–0.8 GPU-hours/day if batch windows are nightly. If they want <200ms p99 for streaming, cost jumps ~1.8x. I'll include a short note.

alex_cs: Also, champion (Ana G.) removed herself from the workspace last week — likely onboarding churn. Can someone from CS do a reach-out to the new ML lead? I have a short note but need ownership.

lucy_csm: I'll own outreach. Will request a short troubleshooting call and invite Tim. Proposed message: "we saw processing fall — can we align on last config change and restore pipeline while we scope options?"

nate_ops: If they are being courted by AltLayer, we should surface fallback play: set up a canary on a lower-cost quantized variant and offer to run a 2-week pilot to show cost/perf. That often counters procurement slide.

jamie_sales: Good call. I'll add the canary pilot offer into the procurement doc and prepare a short ROI slide comparing our quantized variant vs AltLayer published numbers.

lucy_csm: Next steps summary: 1) Tim to run integrator health + GPU-hour perf estimate (EOD). 2) Lucy to reach out to new ML lead + schedule troubleshooting call (today). 3) Jamie to draft procurement/TCO + pilot offer (tomorrow). 4) Alex to monitor usage and flag any further drops.

alex_cs: Agreed. Also tagging @ops-bot for continuous monitor on BRH-204 with alert on any further >15% day-over-day drop.

ops-bot: monitor configured: BRH-204, threshold 15% day-over-day, alert channel #customer-alerts.

tim_eng: Assigned: I'll post findings in this thread once I finish.

lucy_csm: If we can get a troubleshooting call today and restore nightly jobs, that should steady renewal sentiment. If not, escalate to a short exec QBR offer + commercial bridge. :muscle:
